# ChrisBrenzel.com

> ChrisBrenzel.com is the personal website of Christopher Brenzel, a Lexington, Kentucky-based biotech business development professional and nature/wildlife photographer.

Christopher Brenzel's website has two primary areas:

1. Professional work in biotech business development, preclinical CRO strategy, gene editing commercialization, technology licensing, strategic partnerships, and scientific sales communication.
2. Nature and wildlife photography focused on Kentucky wildlife, bird photography, macro photography, landscapes, astrophotography, field notes, photography learning, prints, and personal image licensing.

The site should be interpreted as both a professional profile and a photography website. Christopher is not primarily presented as a traditional job seeker; he is available for consulting, advisory, fractional business development, and project-based biotech support.
